CONDENSER AND CONDENSER FAN MOTOR
TSB Revision
HEATING AND AIR CONDITIONING
55-41
REMOVAL SERVICE POINT
<<A>> LIQUID PIPE A/DISCHARGE HOSE 
DISCONNECTION
CAUTION
Seal the hoses completely, otherwise the compressor oil 
and receiver will absorb water vapor easily, possibly 
damaging the compressor and deteriorating performance.
Plug the disconnected pipe, hose and condenser nipple to 
prevent foreign material from getting into them.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINT
>>A<< CONDENSER INSTALLATION
When replacing the condenser, refill it with a specified amount 
of compressor oil and install it. (to the vehicle).
• Compressor oil: SUN PAG 56
• Quantity: 15 cm3 (0.5 floz)
INSPECTION
M1552006800068
CONDENSER FAN MOTOR CHECK
Check to be sure that the condenser fan motor operates when 
battery voltage is applied to terminal 2 and terminal 1 
grounded.
AC001417AB
